notes.title: Alien Boom Boom - Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43941782/f10ea1b0fbe764b4b3583cab5c55997467688402.png[/img]

Reworked the Plasma AR. Shoots slightly slower, has much less recoil, the plasma bolts travel much faster. 
This makes the Plasma AR feel a lot nicer to shoot, and handle better. 

Added some ammo packs around the map, too many people were running out and being forced to use the bat. 

The bat has a much large hit box, so it should be a lot easier to hit targets such as the frogs without needing to land a hit directly on the. (This was a complaint, people wanted the melee to be easier)
Also raised the damage slightly. 

Raised the light levels across the map, next patch will see even better lighting.

notes.title: Alien Boom Boom Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43941782/f10ea1b0fbe764b4b3583cab5c55997467688402.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bat now does less damage, but is also faster to swing
[*] Grenadiers and Men in Black have more health across difficulties
[*] You only face 1 Men in Black at a time now, as they are hit scan and hit you more often
[*] Enemy placements slightly different.
[/list]

[b]Visual Changes [/b]
[list]
[*] Added more detail to terrain and environment.
[*] Added decals (bullet decals and explosive/flame decals working again) 
[/list]

[b]Technical Changes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some minor AI issues.
[*] Updated Engine version to fix decal issue
[/list]

[b]Upcoming patch[/b]
[list]
[*] New voice acting (replacing current), already finished, just need to add it this week
[*] Enemy AI patch. (They will react better when their nearby friends are attacked)
[*] Better enemy audio telegraphing
[/list]
